title: SSSD fails to start when ifp is enabled
description:
CAUSE:
The problem is caused by a missing dependency: the package sssd-dbus which provides sssd_ifp is not installed in the system.

RESOLUTION:
Install the package sssd-dbus:
# zypper install sssd-dbus
then restart SSSD:
# systemctl restart sssd
log_patterns: Could not exec /usr/lib/sssd/sssd_ifp --uid 0 --gid 0 --logger=files, reason: No such file or directory
Exiting the SSSD. Could not restart critical service [ifp].
